player_prompt.intro:
E te taʻalo 2048 i luga o se {board_size}x{board_size} papa. Ou sini e uiga i le auina o se {target_tile} tile e alu i luga o numera tutusa faʻatasi!
Faʻagaioiga talafeagai: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles tuʻufaʻatasi pe a latou teteʻe, faʻalogo a latou luafale.

invalid_move.no_change: Board did not change - choose a different direction.

outcome.win: Faʻafetai, na e auaina {target_tile}! Faʻamaumauga faʻaiʻu {score}.
outcome.lose: E leai ni gaioiga e toe. Max tile {max_tile} - faʻamaumauga faʻaiʻu {score}.
